_readme: Example ~/Library/Application Support/Ghost/profile.json for Ghost Desktop. Everything in it is the FICTIONAL demo profile (Alex Chen).
Copy it there (Ghost reloads within a second), or add only the resumePath line to the profile Ghost seeded.
resumePath / coverLetterPath: an absolute path (a leading ~/ is expanded) to an existing, readable pdf, doc, docx, rtf, txt, odt or pages file under 25 MB.
The path below points at the fictional resume in this repository (demo/fixtures/resume-alex-chen.pdf) for a checkout at ~/Projects/htn2026; change it if your checkout lives elsewhere.

A path that fails these checks is dropped on load (the log names the key and a reason code, never the path). Paths never leave the machine: the prediction server only ever sees fact names, and the HUD shows the file name only.
This _readme key is ignored when the profile is loaded.
